upstream.description: Apache OFBiz is an open source product for the automation of enterprise processes. It includes framework components and business applications for ERP, CRM, E-Business/E-Commerce, Supply Chain Management and Manufacturing Resource Planning. OFBiz provides a foundation and starting point for reliable, secure and scalable enterprise solutions.

license_review.scope: Top-level historical license and redistribution terms checked. Preserve all per-file notices and bundled licenses; no relicensing or execution. Not an exhaustive dependency audit.

scope: One selected source repository, not its complete ecosystem or history. External submodules, dependencies and LFS content are not downloaded.
modifications: Original archive files are byte-for-byte unchanged. Only .snapshot-info/ was added by the collection.
